_comment: Active-space switch: model space vs a paper layout. The Capture step scopes the ExportScene to the model's ACTIVE space (DrawingExporter.exportSpace(forActiveSpace:)), so switching the active space changes WHAT is rendered. We put one circle in MODEL space and a DIFFERENT rectangle (4 lines) in a paper layout 'Layout1', render MODEL (only the circle), then activate Layout1 and render PAPER (only the rectangle) — two distinct PNGs proving the space scoping. Outputs: layout-switch-model.png and layout-switch-paper.png (the wrapper's default single-PNG path is unused here because this scene renders twice with explicit paths).
